name: Harsh
experience: 1+ years crafting visual stories for brands, agencies, and creators. Specialized in motion graphics, narrative editing, and color grading. Passionate about turning raw footage into compelling narratives that connect with audiences.
story:
I started editing videos in my bedroom at 16, piecing together gaming montages and short films. What began as a hobby became an obsession with the craft of visual storytelling.

After studying digital media, I worked with production houses and creative agencies, learning the discipline of commercial work while keeping my experimental edge. I've edited everything from 15-second social spots to documentary features.

Today, I collaborate with brands and creators who value craft. Every project gets the same attention to rhythm, color, and narrative structure—whether it's a product launch or a passion project.

When I'm not in the timeline, you'll find me studying film, experimenting with new techniques, or shooting reference footage for personal work.
